services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a Two Hour Cruise Towards Big Pass to Watch a Beautiful Sarasota Sunset Over the Gulf. Rates Adults: $40 Children (3-12): $37 Infants ages 2 and under: Free Duration Aprox. 2 Hours About There is no better way to enjoy a sunset than on a boat in Sarasota Bay! Join us as we cruise along the Sarasota Bay coastline listening to music as well as some light narration about our local wildlife, history, and spectacular bayfront homes. Before heading back to the dock we will journey to Big Pass to watch a spectacular Sarasota Sunset over the Gulf. services.name: Christmas Boat Parade
services.desc: The Christmas Boat Parade of lights is an excellent way to start your holiday season. Join us as we celebrate by riding in the parade or spectating. Our boat will be decorated for the parade and we will enjoy classic Christmas music along the way. We will be selling soda, water, and chips aboard; however, feel free to bring your own drinks and snacks in a small cooler. (All open alcoholic beverages must be corked or consumed before docking). The vessel will return to the dock shortly after the parade making this trip roughly 2 hours. Please take note of which boat you are reserving as we will have two boats set to cruise in the parade. services.name: Sea Life Encounter Cruise
services.desc: For all ages! Duration 1.75 hours Check - in is 30 minutes prior to departure. About Guided by an experienced marine biologist, this eco boat tour on Sarasota Bay showcases the area’s diverse wildlife, including the Florida manatee and bottlenose dolphins. The highlight of this trip is the collection of samples of marine life using a trawl net to discover critters living at the bottom of Sarasota Bay. This eco boat tour will also navigate around bird rookery islands, perfect for spotting birds such as pelicans, herons, ibis and egrets. services.name: 4th of July
services.desc: For all ages! About Join us as we celebrate the 4th of July on the water. We will head out to get into position closer to downtown to watch the fire works over downtown Sarasota. There is no better way to watch the fireworks on the 4th than on the water. It's a great way to start new family traditions. More information Small coolers allowed.
